name: PR416 widened tackle corpus

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-widened-tackle-corpus.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  widened-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - label: pinned-main
            ref: 1bad655f5826070d1e29f54a845cdf2c549f66bc
            ablate: false
          - label: pr416-control
            ref: 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad
            ablate: false
          - label: rolling-preforce-ablation
            ref: 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad
            ablate: true

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch frozen evidence inputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-mechanism-census evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused evidence/pr416-pre-force-normalization-ablation

      - name: Apply exact localized pair ablation
        if: matrix.ablate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-no-rolling-focused -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs
          git checkout origin/evidence/pr416-pre-force-normalization-ablation -- src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs)" = "3297dd5a90c8881c510fa1869d34821d395f2a7f"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs)" = "5fbdb6b44b4f623311e122f72a1b4ccf20e4b228"
          test "$(git hash-object src/ball-physics/BallCollision.cs)" = "d58e69016875df3ba360b1364bf5d5a85e9b5766"
          git diff --check 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad -- src/ball-physics/BallStateMachine.cs src/ball-physics/BallPhysicsCore.cs

      - name: Install frozen widened census helper
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git show origin/evidence/pr416-mechanism-census:.github/evidence/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p = Path("src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs")
          s = p.read_text()
          import re
          s, ticks_n = re.subn(
              r"private const int Ticks\s*=\s*150_000;",
              "private const int Ticks = 324_000;",
              s,
              count=1)
          s, seed_n = re.subn(
              r"(0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978UL,\s*\r?\n\s*0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,)",
              r"\1\n            0x5EED000000000003UL,",
              s,
              count=1)
          if ticks_n != 1 or seed_n != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"helper rewrite mismatch ticks={ticks_n} seeds={seed_n}")
          p.write_text(s)
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run widened mechanism census
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }}
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=MeasurePr416MechanismCensus" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }}.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }} \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }}/console.log

      - name: Upload widened evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-widened-${{ matrix.label }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
